description: Run stripe-webhook-wiring with STRIPE_SECRET_KEY from this server's environment: confirms a live-mode key is in use, that at least one enabled webhook endpoint points at the production host, and that it subscribes to the checkout and subscription events. The key is trimmed, sent only to api.stripe.com, and never appears in the output. Provide productionHost so the endpoint host can be compared.

productionHost.description: The production hostname or URL the webhook should point at, for example my-app.example.

name: check_stripe
title: Check Stripe webhook wiring
